name: Revalidate Open Picks

# Re-checks every open, locked pick from today against current conditions
# (line movement, injuries, edge decay) via core/revalidation_engine.py,
# and CONFIRMs / UPGRADEs / DOWNGRADEs / VOIDs it. Never creates new
# picks -- the published slate from generate_daily_picks.yml is
# immutable; this only annotates it, and sends a Telegram alert on the
# two conditions revalidation_engine.py's own governance rules permit
# (edge loss past 50% decay, edge reversal to negative EV) for picks that
# were actually sent to the group.
#
# Runs multiple times through the games window (roughly noon-11pm ET,
# covering both early and late MLB/WNBA start times) rather than once,
# since a single run 30-60 minutes before EVERY game's individual start
# time isn't possible with one fixed cron -- catching most games within
# an hour of first pitch/tip across a few passes is the practical
# approximation of the "30-60 min before game time" spec.
#
# data/results.db is gitignored (avoids binary merge conflicts -- see
# that .gitignore entry) so it can't persist via a git commit the way
# pick_history.jsonl does. It persists across these runs via
# actions/cache instead (restore-keys prefix match picks up whatever
# generate_daily_picks.yml or an earlier run of this workflow last
# saved today; each run saves its own updated copy back under a new
# key). This is the same mechanism added to generate_daily_picks.yml's
# generate-picks job.
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 17 * * *'   # 17:00 UTC = 12:00 PM ET
    - cron: '0 20 * * *'   # 20:00 UTC = 3:00 PM ET
    - cron: '0 23 * * *'   # 23:00 UTC = 6:00 PM ET
    - cron: '0 2  * * *'   # 02:00 UTC = 9:00 PM ET (previous calendar day ET)
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry_run:
        description: 'Evaluate and log only, do not write changes or send alerts'
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  revalidate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Restore data/results.db from cache
        uses: actions/cache/restore@v4
        with:
          path: data/results.db
          key: results-db-${{ github.run_id }}
          restore-keys: |
            results-db-

      - name: Run revalidation
        env:
          BALL_DONT_LIE_KEY: ${{ secrets.BALL_DONT_LIE_KEY }}
          THE_ODDS_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.THE_ODDS_API_KEY }}
          PROP_LINE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.PROP_LINE_API_KEY }}
          RAPIDAPI_KEY: ${{ secrets.RAPIDAPI_KEY }}
          TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN }}
          TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID: ${{ secrets.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID }}
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event.inputs.dry_run }}" = "true" ]; then
            python3 run_revalidation.py --dry-run
          else
            python3 run_revalidation.py
          fi

      - name: Save data/results.db to cache
        if: always()
        uses: actions/cache/save@v4
        with:
          path: data/results.db
          key: results-db-${{ github.run_id }}
